text.zh:
本程式會備份此裝置的音效設定、接入內建音訊核心，並開啟左右互換。
電腦音訊服務會重新啟動，所有裝置的聲音會短暫中斷；完成時會播放兩聲短音檢查核心。
text.en:
Channel Flip will back up this device's audio effects settings, attach the built-in audio core, and turn on left/right swapping.
Windows audio services will restart, briefly interrupting sound on all devices. Two short tones will then check the core.

text.zh: 所有音訊輸出的聲音會短暫中斷。
text.en: Sound on all audio outputs will be briefly interrupted.

text.zh: 影響的已設定裝置：

關閉所有互換：只恢復這些裝置的左右方向，保留核心與系統設定。
移除所有裝置的設定：還原本程式管理的裝置音效、核心登記及音訊宿主設定，包含離線裝置。外部程式已修改的設定會保留。
重新啟動或移除時，整台電腦的音訊會短暫中斷。
text.en:
Turn off all swaps: restore the original channel direction on these devices, keeping the core and system settings.
Remove all device settings: restore the device effects, core registration, and audio host settings managed by Channel Flip, including offline devices. Changes made by other programs are preserved.
Restarting audio or removing settings briefly interrupts sound across the computer.

text.zh: · 已離線
· 系統預設
· 模擬
（目前離線）

1. 選擇耳機或喇叭。首次按「設定此裝置」；完成後使用左右互換開關。
2. 分別測試來源左、右聲道，再依聽到的方向確認。設定開啟不代表每個播放程式都已通過核心；運作狀態以近期處理證據顯示。
3. 固定裝置會保留離線目標。跟隨系統預設只更新視窗的操作目標，各裝置設定獨立保存，新裝置仍須先設定。
關閉視窗後，已接入裝置的互換設定會保留。進階設定可以關閉所有互換、重新啟動電腦音訊服務，或移除所有裝置的設定。
作用範圍是所選裝置的 Windows 共用模式音訊。獨佔模式、ASIO、RAW 及停用音效強化可能繞過核心；藍牙免持模式可能是另一個端點。
本程式採 MIT 授權，內建自己的音訊核心，無須 Equalizer APO。未簽章預覽版的音訊宿主設定影響整台電腦，部分 DRM 音訊可能受影響。
text.en:
1. Select your headphones or speakers. Choose Set up this device the first time, then use the Swap left/right switch.
2. Test the left and right source channels separately, then confirm the direction you hear. An enabled setting does not prove that every player passes through the core; processing status uses recent counter changes.
3. Fixed device keeps the same target while it is offline. Follow system default updates the target shown in the window. Each device keeps its own settings; a new device still needs setup.
Closing the window keeps swap settings on configured devices. Advanced settings lets you turn off all swaps, restart Windows audio services, or remove all device settings.
Processing applies to the selected device's Windows shared-mode audio path. Exclusive mode, ASIO, RAW, and disabled audio enhancements may bypass the core. Bluetooth hands-free mode may use another endpoint.
Channel Flip is MIT licensed and includes its own audio core; Equalizer APO is not required. This unsigned preview changes a system-wide audio host setting and may affect protected DRM audio.
